text:
Noah Rivera: Heads-up: Marketplace reported increased error rates for int8 quant models after pushing runtime that bundles driver 538 + CUDA12.4. SI customers on integration clusters are seeing timeouts and p99 spikes.

Maya Chen: Which hardware did they hit? Any reproducible testcases?

Noah Rivera: Primarily H100 and a few A100 reports. SI provided a small reproducer and a perf CSV. I'll attach in the ticket.

Olga Petrov: Quick triage: we ran the reproducer in our lab. Trace shows tiled matmul path choosing a new schedule in driver 538 that increases kernel occupancy variability. Effect pronounced on quant paths.

Sam Lin (CloudForge): CloudForge customers paused their canary rollout after a couple of customer complaints. Can you recommend an immediate mitigation?

Maya Chen: Short mitigation options: 1) Pin marketplace images to driver 525.x for now, 2) Offer an explicit canary lane that uses 525 for quant-heavy customers, 3) Apply a runtime switch to prefer the legacy int8 kernel path. Each has tradeoffs.

Talia (SI-Bridge): SI-Bridge will block downstream integrator images until we confirm stability. Customers want a timeline for fixes.

Noah Rivera: Ops suggestion: implement a temporary safety-net in the marketplace pipeline that auto-stops promotion if p99_quant increases > 25% vs baseline AND error rate > 0.5%. That prevents mass rollouts.

Maya Chen: Agreed. Priors: baseline metrics are from the last stable GA (driver 525 lane). I'll draft a gating rule.

vendor-ops-bot: Auto-check: current GA images in registry with driver>=536 flagged for manual review.

Olga Petrov: Vendor note: our kernel debug points to a scheduling heuristic change in 538. We'll prepare a minimal driver recommendation (either micro-patch or fallback knob) within 48h.

Sam Lin (CloudForge): Please include exact image tags we should pause. We'll stop promotions and notify our release board.

Noah Rivera: Pause list: marketplace/gpu-runtime:*538* and marketplace/gpu-runtime:*536-2* (recent variants). We'll publish a safe list of recommended images (525.85 family).

Maya Chen: I'll spin up A/B canaries: lane-A uses 525.85+CUDA12.4, lane-B uses 538+CUDA12.4. Tests: perf (avg/p99), errors, and a small correctness eval on quantized outputs.

deploy-bot: Canary jobs queued -> job-10111 (525), job-10112 (538). Artifacts will land in s3.

Talia (SI-Bridge): SI customers request an embargoed joint advisory we can share with our SI teams. Can we draft a short template?

Noah Rivera: Draft suggestion (two bullets): 1) Symptom: increased tail latency/errors for quantized workloads on driver 538 variants. 2) Action: Marketplace rollout paused for affected driver builds; recommended fallback driver 525.85; vendor patch ETA 48h.

Olga Petrov: We'll also add a temporary runtime knob: export REDWOOD_QUANT_KERNEL=legacy to prefer old matmul path. That gives customers a hotfix option while driver patch is validated. We'll document risks.

Sam Lin (CloudForge): If we publish a runtime knob, can we include a simple kubectl patch snippet for marketplace consumers? That helps customers apply a workaround quickly.

Maya Chen: I'll include a snippet in the partner advisory and test the knob in canary. Also will add the knob to the rollout gating tests.

deploy-bot: job-10111 (525) completed: avg_token_ms 1.9ms, p99 3.0ms, error_rate 0.12%. job-10112 (538) completed: avg_token_ms 2.7ms, p99 4.9ms, error_rate 1.1%. Canary delta confirms regression.

Noah Rivera: Good data. Action items recap: Maya to publish canary logs + partner advisory draft; Olga to surface driver micro-patch or recommend REDWOOD_QUANT_KERNEL fallback; Sam to hold CloudForge promotions and notify customers; Talia to coordinate SI communications.

Maya Chen: I'll post the advisory and a short public-facing blurb for marketplace release notes (non-technical). ETA 2h.

Olga Petrov: NV-driver team exception: we expect a candidate patch within 36-48h. We'll attach QA matrix for A100/H100.

Noah Rivera: We'll keep the safety-net gate in place until we validate the vendor patch on our full perf matrix and confirm no quality regressions. Next check-in in 12h or when patch lands.

Sam Lin (CloudForge): Thanks all. We'll coordinate a joint announcement if the issue affects broader customers. Keep me posted in this thread.

vendor-ops-bot: Action created: PARTNERS-3214 (owner: Olga Petrov)

Noah Rivera: Closing thread for now — update when the patch or runtime-knob verification complete. Thanks team.
